prototype.strategy: Reuse the stable V7.3 UI and substitute only the comparison engine; do not fork or migrate the whole UI.

reasons: The public production root is V7.3 Stable while the original rollout contract assumed V8 was already production.
v9-app is still a technical validation harness with enrollment/scenario controls and pre-canary copy, not the production user application shell.
A stable-UI/V9-engine shell now exists only in shadow mode; it must pass artifact and device validation before it can become the public canary target.
requiredBeforeUserCanary: Promote the stable-UI/V9-engine shell from shadow to candidate only after its mapping and fallback tests are green.
Declare the actual production control version and path explicitly instead of assuming V8.
Make every bootstrap/config/runtime failure continue on the control application without a redirect loop.
Verify the production Pages artifact contains the pinned candidate runtime and its pinned data dependencies.
Run routing smoke tests proving deterministic 1% allocation and zero user exposure when this readiness file is BLOCKED.
notes: This gate separates engine validation from user-facing production exposure. The shell prototype deliberately reuses V7.3 UI and keeps public traffic at 0% while preserving the completed V9 engine observation.
